title: SectionIndex configs
description: The configs JSON string of OutSystems.OSUI.Patterns.SectionIndexAPI.Create, parsed. Invalid values fall back to the defaults at runtime; unknown properties are ignored. Generated by scripts/ai-docs/generate-ai-docs.mjs.

IsFixed.description: Keeps the index fixed while the page scrolls.

SmoothScrolling.description: Animates the scroll to the target section.

ExtendedClass.description: CSS classes added to the pattern root; always present, empty by default.
